patthana16.30:1.1: savitakkasavicāraṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na savitakkasavicāro na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā paṇṇarasa.
patthana16.30:2.1: savitakkasavicāraṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na avitakkavicāramatto na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā aṭṭhavīsa. pītittika hetuduke napītittika nahetudukaṃ
